verdict.left_looks: A dark black-walled cafe/shop on a light grey stone-brick plinth. A wide overhanging flat roof with a dark top band and a brown wood-plank fascia strip. Front has a small porch with wooden steps, lanterns, a wooden door, an orange accent block, and green leafy hedge/bush planters at the front and sides. The side view shows a mostly solid black wall with a narrow grey stone-brick base wall that steps up at one corner. Overall: a moody, fairly closed-looking box with a porch and plantings.
verdict.right_looks: A long, mostly glazed black-framed shopfront with grey-framed window grids and large glass panes showing warm interior furniture and crates. Black pillars divide the bays, and a grey-brown flat roof band caps it. The base is a checkered black and light-stone tile strip. A wooden door sits in the front. Interior detail (sofas, crates, shelves, plants) is visible through the glass. Clean, consistent, and well-proportioned rhythm across the facade; the side view shows the glazing continuing along the length.
verdict.why: The right build has a readable shopfront rhythm of pillars, glazing bays, and a checkered base with visible interior life, while the left reads as a mostly blank black box whose roof and porch carry the design.
